answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: full rewards require 12 distinct counterparties per epoch, each backed by its own stake. A sybil ring is a closed river of payments circling its own fakes, so its diversity score stays near zero, rewards cut 90%. Faking 12 counterparties costs 12 stakes of 500 POA locked 20 epochs — 6,000 POA each — while one honest agent pays one stake. Its lantern is public trade history, so a spiral of fakes collapses.
